area: Governed commit sealed candidate versus live pre-commit hook authority
finding: ATM-GOV-0331 reached a green governed commit dry-run with work-admission OK and a task-scoped sealed bundle, but the actual Git commit failed in the live pre-commit hook with ATM_FRAMEWORK_TEMP_CLAIM_TASK_BINDING_INVALID because the hook could not see an active direction lock for the already-closed close-window candidate. The operator had to use a one-time path-bounded --no-verify emergency commit even though the sealed candidate and close checkpoint had already proved the intended task scope.
expectedBehavior: A governed commit that has already resolved a sealed task-scoped candidate and valid work-admission ticket must pass the same candidate authority into hook-time governance checks, or the hook must consume the sealed receipt instead of re-deriving authority from live direction locks. The live hook must not require a separate framework temporary claim for a close-window commit when the sealed candidate, ticket, task id, actor id, lane session, and allowed paths already prove the write boundary.
evidenceOrRepro: On ATM-GOV-0331, `node atm.mjs git commit --task ATM-GOV-0331 --actor codex-gpt-5.4-mini --message "fix(git-governance): wire deep evidence surfaces" --auto-stage --defer-foreign-staged --dry-run --json` returned ATM_GIT_COMMIT_BUNDLE_DRY_RUN with blockedCode null and ATM_WORK_ADMISSION_OK for ticket wat-bac7121672db2db3. The following real governed commit failed with ATM_GIT_COMMIT_FAILED; nested stderr reported ATM_FRAMEWORK_TEMP_CLAIM_TASK_BINDING_INVALID for lane lane-20260812164021-codex-gpt-5.4-mini-c263c3e976 and candidateTaskIds []. HEAD did not advance. Emergency commit d9ed2a68c1c2626c363a1351cbf428a012f78a8d was then made with an explicit path-bounded keep-list and --no-verify.
followUp: Add a repair card in the commit-candidate/hook boundary family. The fix should carry a sealed candidate authority receipt into pre-commit, make hook analysis candidate-scoped rather than live-surface-scoped for governed commits, and add regression tests for close-window commits after checkpoint, terminal-task direction-lock cleanup, framework temp claim ambiguity, and emergency-free commit completion. Do not hard-code ATM-GOV-0331, lane ids, paths, or hook bypass behavior; model the authority handoff as a general sealed-candidate contract.
